findings.title: Missing HSTS Header
findings.description: The server is not enforcing HTTPS via HSTS. Browsers may allow HTTP connections.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The page can be embedded in iframes, enabling clickjacking attacks.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
findings.description: No CSP header found. XSS attacks may be more impactful.
findings.solution: Implement a Content-Security-Policy header to restrict resource loading.

findings.title: Wildcard CORS Policy
findings.description: The server returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * which allows any origin to make cross-origin requests.
findings.solution: Restrict CORS to known, trusted origins. Avoid wildcard for authenticated endpoints.

findings.title: Stack trace detected
findings.description: Java/Node.js stack trace may leak internal paths
findings.solution: Disable verbose error output in production. Configure a custom error page.

findings.title: Sensitive Page May Be Cached
findings.description: The response does not set cache-control: no-store, meaning sensitive content could be cached by proxies or browsers.
findings.solution: Set Cache-Control: no-store, private for pages with sensitive content.

findings.title: security.txt Missing Contact Field
findings.description: A security.txt file is served but contains no Contact field. RFC 9116 requires at least one Contact entry.
findings.solution: Add one or more Contact lines (mailto:, tel:, or https: URI) to security.txt.

findings.title: security.txt Missing Expires
findings.description: A security.txt file is served but has no Expires field. RFC 9116 §2.5.5 requires this field to bound the file's validity.
findings.solution: Add an Expires line with an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z).

findings.title: Missing X-XSS-Protection Header
findings.description: Legacy XSS filter header not present (affects older browsers).

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.description: No Permissions-Policy header restricting browser feature access.
findings.solution: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict access to camera, microphone, etc.

findings.title: Technology Stack Fingerprint
findings.description: The response leaks information about the underlying technology stack via headers, generators, or script paths. By itself this is informational; combined with known CVEs it accelerates exploitation.
findings.solution: Strip Server, X-Powered-By, X-AspNet-Version and similar headers; remove generator meta tags; avoid versioned asset paths.
